placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
The Strawberry Line follows the former railway through the North Somerset countryside. Starting at Yatton makes an out-and-back walk straightforward, with no need to complete the full route to enjoy the landscape.

Our family idea: set a gentle turning point before you begin and watch for birds in the surrounding wetlands. Leave space for cyclists and take breaks off the main path.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families wanting a flexible walk on a shared walking and cycling trail.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Trail access from Yatton station; bring drinks for the walk.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Yatton station parking is charged; arriving by train is another option.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Check current closure notices before travel. The full trail includes road crossings, and surface conditions vary with weather.
